lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce2Hg4N4O12 (reduced formula Ce(HgN2O3)2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers coordinated by eight O neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, while Hg adopts a tetrahedral environment of four N neighbors and N is tetrahedrally coordinated by one Hg and three O. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Hg and N tetrahedra and corner-sharing between N tetrahedra and Ce 8-vertex polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
